purpose: Immutable source-required whole-method floors. Old/custom profiles, omitted plan keys, lower observations and removed self-reported costs cannot reduce them. All are unmeasured engineering assumptions, never runtime bounds.

ProjectStoryTemplateAlbumEndFlowTests.te.basis: Entire one-launch method with all shared helpers, Back/Refresh/Close cancellation, fresh-list reopen, source reread on Apply, exact local save, cold coordinator reconstruction and stored-envelope restore and resave of the actual restored editor, second read-only reopen, all assertions and conditional failure screenshot and termination. This is a conservative engineering planning assumption, not an observed runtime or hard upper bound.

derivation.other_overhead_scope: Three direct navigation-back taps outside the 24/27 tap-helper calls; remaining navigation/taps, SwiftUI transitions, JSON decoding/byte assertions and recursive equality, album assertion loops, AX queries outside reveal iterations, restore/resave checks, conditional failure screenshot and termination. This is an allocated unmeasured allowance, not independently measured overhead.
derivation.assumption_limit: 117 seconds is a common engineering planning allowance, not a source-derived duration. End-gap methods retain 30 seconds explicit rounding reserve. These hypotheses need Apple runtime validation; 900 is not a measured or guaranteed upper bound.
